title: Merge K Sorted Lists
description: You are given an array of k linked-lists lists, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order. Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return it.
hints: You know how to merge 2 sorted lists. Can you extend that?
Use a Min-Heap (Priority Queue) to always pick the smallest current node across all lists.

optimalSolution.approach: Priority Queue (Min-Heap). Add first node of each list to heap. Poll minimum, add to result, add next node of that list to heap. O(N log k) where N = total nodes, k = lists.

followUpQuestions: What is the time complexity of the heap approach vs brute force?
What if memory is very limited?
Can you do it with divide and conquer?
interviewerNotes: Classic HARD problem. Tests linked list manipulation + heap usage. Ideal for SDE-2+ candidates. Look for clean dummy node pattern and correct heap initialization. The divide-and-conquer approach is a great follow-up.
